arguments.name: dsDivisionCode
arguments.description: DS Division code to search for (exact match) (optional)

raw.name: dsDivisionCode
raw.description: DS Division code to search for (exact match) (optional)

arguments.name: dsDivisionName
arguments.description: DS Division name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive) (optional)

raw.name: dsDivisionName
raw.description: DS Division name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive) (optional)

arguments.name: fetchDetails
arguments.description: Whether to fetch detailed information (including district code) when a single DS Division is found. Accepts "yes" or "no". Defaults to "yes". Set to "no" to skip the detail fetch and return only grid data. (optional)

raw.name: fetchDetails
raw.description: Whether to fetch detailed information (including district code) when a single DS Division is found. Accepts "yes" or "no". Defaults to "yes". Set to "no" to skip the detail fetch and return only grid data. (optional)

arguments.name: districtName
arguments.description: District name (partial match, case-insensitive). Uses criteria value D.DISTRICT_NAME. (optional)

raw.name: districtName
raw.description: District name (partial match, case-insensitive). Uses criteria value D.DISTRICT_NAME. (optional)

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
"yes" to return all DS Divisions (clicks Show All).
Also auto-triggers if any search value is one of: "all", "available", "existing", "list", "show all".

raw.name: returnAll

arguments.description: If you want to set the initial page size for the first search request. The tool will still adapt to the UI page size after the first response.
